errors.evidence: At 80% sparsity, the blue bar (Per-Output) is below 10³, while the orange bar (Per-Layer) reaches approximately 10³. The description incorrectly states both are approximately 10³.
The x-axis label is 'Sparsity rates' (plural), not 'Sparsity Rate' (singular).
The description does not explicitly state that the values remain below 10² until 70% sparsity.
The description does not mention that at 60% sparsity, the orange bar is slightly above 10¹ while the blue bar is still below 10¹.
The description oversimplifies the trend by stating both bar heights increase 'significantly' without noting that the orange bars are taller than the blue bars at 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80% sparsity.

errors.text_span: The bars are not shaded or annotated beyond their color coding and are visually grouped side-by-side for each sparsity rate
